title: 第1613章 白老头的底细
slug: 顶级奸商无敌从贩卖军火开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

【他？九重天？？】

林风瞪大双眼，满脸不可思议。

完全无法相信，他居然是9重天，不，曾经是！

整个天下只有两个官方承认的9重天。

骗他钱的人曾经是9重天。

林风再次看向白老的院子：【我没有看错。】

说罢，起身和众人告辞。

【诸位，我有事，先告辞！】

【年轻人，希望你仙途坦荡。】

老药师爽朗一笑，林风却从他的眼底，看到一丝落寞。

其他两人也同时祝福，只是用他们国家的方式祝福。

什么登神成功啊之类的。

【有什么困难尽管找我们，我们能帮的一定帮。】

林风点头称谢。

这些人嘴上说这里潇洒。

但是，骨子里还是希望自己能够突破9重天，眼神中的落寞已经出卖他们。

哪怕这里的生活潇洒，可真正能达到半步9重天的高手，哪个人能承受住这份寂寞。

他再次来到院子外。

看着躺在院子里的白老头。

开口质问道：【喂，老头，你不是说你说的情报只有你一个人知道吗？还钱！】

【帅气的少年，是只有我一个人知道，他们都不是人。】

【我……】

太不要脸了，这老货居然脸不红心不跳。

林风深吸一口气，平复心情后笑着说道：【白老，你说你都这样了，为什么还要钱？钱我多的是啊，别说50万，50亿我都拿的出来！】

白老头刚才还欠扁悠闲样子瞬间消失，眼睛放光看着林风：【50亿？帅气的少年，你确定你有？】

【呵呵，你这些年，有见过其他人飞上来吗？】

【还真没有。】

【身为绝世高手，你应该知道，在天下世界里，有实力赚钱有多容易。】

【嘶~少年郎，你说的我心痒痒，你到底有多少钱？】

【几万亿？还是几十万亿？】

【什么？？？？】

白老瞬间来到林风面前，热情的拉起他的手，满眼都是暧昧：【帅气的少年啊，你经受住我的考验了，我决定将只有我知道的秘密告诉你。】

林风眼神怪异的看着他：【白老，你是不是得了什么病？成仙的执念太重了？】

【呔。。帅气的小伙，不要想那么多，只随本心，你要得到的，我这里都有。】

【好，我要买那个东西！】

林风指着房屋内，摆放的一个花瓶说道。

白老头眼睛放光：【那可不便宜，1…千万金币。】

content_en:
Page (1/3)

【Him?Nine Heavens??】

Lin Feng's eyes widened with disbelief on his face.

I can't believe it at all. He is actually the ninth heaven. No, he was once!

There are only two officially recognized ninth heavens in the entire world.

The person who defrauded him of money was once the 9th Heaven.

Lin Feng looked at Bai Lao's yard again: [I read that right.】

After that, he stood up and said goodbye to everyone.

[Everyone, I have something to do, so I’ll take my leave first!】

[Young man, I hope your path to immortality will be smooth and smooth.】

The old pharmacist smiled heartily, but Lin Feng saw a hint of loneliness in his eyes.

The other two also blessed at the same time, but in the way of their countries.

What kind of success in becoming a god?

[If you have any difficulties, just come to us, we will definitely help you if we can.】

Lin Feng nodded in thanks.

These people say it's cool here.

However, deep down, they still hope that they can break through the 9th level, and the loneliness in their eyes has betrayed them.

Even if the life here is unrestrained, who can truly reach the half-step to the 9th level of the heaven can bear this loneliness.

He came outside the yard again.

Looking at the old man lying in the yard.

He opened his mouth and asked: [Hey, old man, didn’t you say that you are the only one who knows the information you mentioned?Pay back the money!】

[I am the only one who knows about the handsome young man, they are not human.】

【I...】

It's so shameless, this old guy doesn't even blush.

Lin Feng took a deep breath, calmed down and said with a smile: [Lao Bai, you said you are like this, why do you still need money?I have plenty of money, let alone 500,000, I can even take out 5 billion!】

The old man Bai's leisurely look disappeared instantly and he looked at Lin Feng with bright eyes: [5 billion?Handsome young man, are you sure you have it?】

[Haha, have you seen anyone else fly up in these years?】

【Not really.】

[As a peerless master, you should know how easy it is to make money with strength in the world.】

[Hiss~Young man, you are making my heart itch. How much money do you have?】

[How many trillions?Or tens of trillions?】

【What????】

Bai Lao came to Lin Feng in an instant, took his hand enthusiastically, his eyes full of ambiguity: [Handsome young man, you have withstood my test, I decided to tell you the secret that only I know.】

Lin Feng looked at him with strange eyes: [Lao Bai, are you suffering from some disease?Is the obsession with becoming an immortal too strong?】

【Bah..Handsome young man, don't think so much, just follow your heart. Whatever you want, I have it here.】

[Okay, I want to buy that thing!】

Lin Feng pointed to a vase placed inside the house and said.

Old Man Bai’s eyes shone: [That’s not cheap, 10 million gold coins.】
